subject: Demo request: GitHub integration + onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Liu <jordan@openlib.org>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Subject: Demo request: GitHub integration + onboarding
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700

Hi Camila,

I signed up for Redwood's self-serve yesterday to test inference on a couple of our open-source models. We're evaluating a few vendors, but Redwood's GitHub mentions and community samples caught my eye.

A few quick questions before a demo:
- Does Redwood support connecting directly to GitHub repos (private + public) for model artifacts and CI-based deploys?
- How does credentialing work for private repos (deploy keys vs. service accounts)?
- Any recommended approach for SSO and RBAC for infra teams?

Would love to schedule a quick 30-min demo next week (week of Jun 29). We're a small infra team (3 engineers + 1 product manager). Best times are mornings PST.

Repo for context (public): https://github.com/openlib/project-repo

Thanks,
Jordan Liu
Lead Engineer, OpenLib
jordan@openlib.org

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan@openlib.org>
Subject: Re: Demo request: GitHub integration + onboarding
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:40:00 -0700

Hi Jordan — great to meet you and thanks for signing up!

I can definitely set up a 30-minute demo to walk through GitHub integration, repo access options, and SSO/RBAC patterns we typically recommend. A couple quick asks to make the demo most useful:
- Can you confirm whether the repo you linked is the main model repo we should look at?
- Are you planning to use hosted Redwood (hosted API) or a private/Dedicated deployment? Any compliance constraints?

Here are a few 30-min slots I have next week:
- Tue 6/30 9:30–10:00 AM PT
- Wed 7/1 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Thu 7/2 9:00–9:30 AM PT

You can also pick a time directly on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/camila-30m

I'll loop in Alex Martinez (AE) to join the call — he can walk through integration patterns and next steps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
SDR, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Liu <jordan@openlib.org>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Demo request: GitHub integration + onboarding
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700

Thanks Camila — the linked repo is the one we want to demo. A few specifics to cover if possible:
- We host model training artifacts in Git LFS; can Redwood pull large files or do we need a separate artifact store?
- Private repo access: we'd prefer short-lived deploy keys or a service principal. Any automation examples?
- SSO: we use Okta; is SCIM provisioning supported?
- On-prem considerations: if we needed private deployment later, what are the typical lead times?

Preferred time: Tue 6/30 9:30 AM PT — that works for our PM and lead engineer.

Attaching a screenshot of our repo permissions settings for reference.

--
Jordan Liu
Lead Engineer, OpenLib
jordan@openlib.org
(attachment: repo-permissions.png)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Liu <jordan@openlib.org>
Subject: Fwd: Demo request: GitHub integration + onboarding — scheduled Tue 6/30 9:30 AM PT
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:25:00 -0700

Alex / Marissa — forwarding an inbound lead (OpenLib). They signed up via self-serve and asked specifically about GitHub integration, LFS artifacts, Okta SSO, and on-prem timelines.

I've penciled in Tue 6/30 9:30–10:00 AM PT (Jordan confirmed). Please confirm if you can take the demo — priority is to:
- Walk through repo connection options (deploy keys, OAuth app, service principal)
- Show a quick flow for private repo access and artifact ingestion (LFS guidance)
- Discuss SSO/SCIM integration patterns and provisioning
- Outline Dedicated/Private deployment lead times and support options

Agenda (30m):
1) Intros + current infra (5m)
2) GitHub integration patterns (10m)
3) SSO/permissions + Ops questions (10m)
4) Next steps & pricing/commit options (5m)

Jordan — I created a tentative calendar invite and included a short agenda. Please accept if that time still works: (attachment: 20260629-openlib-demo.ics)

Alex — potential ARR estimate looks like $30–50k annually if they go Dedicated later. Deal id: DL-2026-042.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
SDR, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
